create.name: Lottie Moore
create.bio:
Lottie Moore is a firewalk trainer and animist ceremonialist who runs the Wild Soul Tribe, a school for fire, ancestral and land-based practice rooted in Irish tradition. She came to the work after years as a social worker and in the NHS, followed by a period volunteering in Burkina Faso and leading women's treks in the Atlas Mountains. She qualified first as a firewalk instructor and later as a trainer of trainers, and has studied shamanic practice in Ireland, Scotland and West and North Africa; she describes her role with the Irish term Bean Feasa, a wise woman or healer.

Most of her teaching now takes place in the Boyne Valley in County Meath, near the passage tombs of Brú na Bóinne, where she holds residential certifications for firewalk instructors and masters, an advanced fire ritual training, sweat lodge keeper training, a vision-quest style Fire Quest and a women's gathering called Mná na Tine. Rather than running many firewalks herself, she mostly passes enquiries to the instructors she has trained. She also teaches online, with recorded programmes for people who feel drawn to work as medicine women and men, and offers mentoring for creative and spiritual projects.

courses.title: Firewalk Instructor Training
courses.description: Five nights of residential training in the Boyne Valley to qualify as a Wild Soul firewalk instructor, with the ancestral and ceremonial side of fire work at its centre. Fees are on a sliding scale, with board and lodging paid separately.

courses.title: Master Firewalk Instructor Training
courses.description: A train-the-trainer course for people who want to certify firewalk instructors themselves, held at the same County Meath venue. Accommodation and meals are extra.

courses.title: Tine Na Sinsear ~ Advanced Firewalk Ritualist
courses.description: An advanced residential training in Irish fire ritual for those who already work with fire, run in spring and autumn. It leads to her advanced firewalk ritualist certificate.

courses.title: Sweat Lodge Keeper Training
courses.description: A residential training in building and holding sweat lodge ceremonies, taught at her Boyne Valley venue. The fee is on a sliding scale, with tent accommodation and meals extra.

courses.title: Fire Quest
courses.description: A four-day quest on the land for building a personal relationship with fire through ceremony and time alone. People travel from abroad to take part.

courses.title: Mná Na Tine (Women of the Fire)
courses.description: A long weekend retreat for women around the fire in County Meath, centred on initiation, ritual and community. Places are priced on a sliding scale and can be paid monthly.

courses.title: New Year Revival of Joy Firewalk
courses.description: A New Year's Eve afternoon firewalk at the Wild Soul Retreat Centre, open to people with no experience of walking on fire.

courses.title: Medicine Carriers
courses.description: A recorded online programme for people who sense a calling to work as medicine women or men, with ceremony and a question-and-answer session. It is available straight away after booking.
